evidence_policy.policy_origin: The reader's proof rules were committed (commit 70d86e94) before any capture and are unchanged. Decision rules 3-4 were fixed after the two-document structure probe (acquisition plan 02: hawaiiathletics.com and usctrojans.com 2024) and before any assertion was authored; they only narrow what the reader admits (site-level names it would accept are excluded).
evidence_policy.source_grant: TP48 section 2: at most 80 public HTTP attempts (redirects, failures and retries counted) to NCAA publication hosts or to the official athletics site the retained NCAA organization record names for one of the 16 census programs; a host answering 401/403/429/451 is stopped without retry, polling or bypass; every request, hop, status, header, retrieval instant and raw body is retained privately (never wholesale in Git).
decision_rules: 1 NCAA organization record: exactly one object of the retained NCAA directory member list whose orgId is the organization, naming its official institution name and athletics site (one JSON object).

2 Official season document: a retained HTTP 200 document requested at <that site's host family>/sports/football/schedule/<season>; a failed or stopped request leaves the row UNSUPPORTED with its receipt.

3 Season schedule record: the document's __NUXT_DATA__ devalue element must hold the schedule record pinia > schedule > schedules > 'schedules-football,<season>' whose season title is a label of that season. Site-level, analytics, header, logo or current-season widget names are never name authority.

4 Exact name: that record's school_name must equal the provider name exactly or differ only in apostrophe forms (U+0027, U+2018, U+2019, U+02BB, U+02BC). Any other value stays UNSUPPORTED and is reported.
never: fuzzy, substring, token, fingerprint or edit-distance matching
schedule content, opponents, scores, dates, venues or id coincidence as name authority
a current name projected to another season (each program-season is decided from its own season document)
search snippets, archives, paid tools, accounts or unlinked domains
a predetermined or forced alias count
evidence_policy.authoring_tool: C48-A01 evidence root tools/c48_assert.py (deterministic; reruns give the same bundle)

parameters.name_normalization: BAT-554: html.unescape, NFKD then ASCII, lowercase, '&' -> ' and ', every run of non-alphanumerics -> one space, then the token expansions

content_scope.provider_route: SRC-002 GET /games classification=fbs year=<season> (FBS route only)
content_scope.excluded_seasons_note: 2016-2023 are reconciled in the parent itself; 2026 and earlier eras are not in this sidecar
content_scope.alias_universe: exactly the relation participants without a documented V1 name link

output_identity_scheme: content identity = sha256(canonical content document: contract id and SHA-256, anchors, payload hashes); database identity = sha256(canonical database document); evidence bundle identity = sha256(canonical evidence document: assertions SHA-256 and every bundle file hash). All create-only under canonical/national_reconciliation_aliases_2024_2025/sha256/<identity>.
consumer: bas-national-population-query --reconciliation <successor sqlite> and python -m aggie_analytics.national_population.query --reconciliation <successor sqlite>; never a default; the original V1 sidecar and every default view are unchanged.
non_claims: Alias authority is SEASON_SCOPED_INSTITUTIONAL_DOCUMENT_ASSERTION_RETRIEVED_NOT_PIT: retrieval time is not publication time, and a season document's current rendering is evidence of what it shows at retrieval, not proof of in-season historical publication.
The NCAA directory member list is the current directory (retrieved 2026-10-09), an institutional identity record, not a season document.
No PIT admission, protected evaluation, default activation, hold release, model or predictive-skill claim.
Unsupported program-seasons are not evidence that no alias exists; they only lack admitted evidence under this bounded grant and policy.
revision_note: V1 of the successor contract; committed before the first canonical write of the successor or its evidence bundle.
